verdict.rationale: The QuickBooks API (via SDKs and the 145-tool MCP server) exposes full CRUD for 29 entity types, which a developer could script to act on many items programmatically, and QBO has some rule-based bulk categorization noted by a community comment. However, there is no explicit documentation of a batch/bulk API endpoint or UI feature for operating on many items in one call. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoint documentation, evidence of bulk UI actions (e.g., bulk invoice edits), and independent confirmation of bulk operation reliability at scale.
